title: Building Inspection Checklist
name: Building Inspection Checklist
description: Structured building inspection record for documenting condition, defects, hold points, corrective actions and sign-off. It records findings and does not itself authorise high-risk work.

sections.title: PREPARATION AND SCOPE
items: The inspection scope and acceptance criteria are understood
Current drawings, specifications and relevant records are available
Safe access to the inspection area has been confirmed
Any separate permit required for access or intrusive inspection is in place
Previous defects, NCRs or outstanding actions relevant to this area have been reviewed

fields.label: Linked Permit References (if required for access or intrusive work)

sections.title: INSPECTION FINDINGS
items: The inspected work is consistent with the available drawings and specification
Visible workmanship and finishes are acceptable for the stage inspected
Required measurements, tests or observations have been recorded
Defects and non-conformances have been clearly identified and evidenced
Any immediate safety issue has been escalated and made safe
Work that must remain visible for inspection has not been covered or closed prematurely

sections.title: CORRECTIVE ACTIONS AND FOLLOW-UP
items: Each required corrective action has a clear owner
Target dates have been set for outstanding actions
Relevant supervisors or package owners have been informed of the findings
The inspection record will be retained with the project quality / safety records
